notes: Scan 019 is a sheet of mathematical diagrams and count tables written in dark ink on printed institutional letterhead. The printed text is transcribed in full. Sheet classification is text, rather than a letter or a typescript: no letter body is present.
The authorial circled 2 at the top is recorded with mspage. The much paler bottom-left 18 is recorded separately with margin as secondary foliation; the identity of that hand is not asserted.

All live and cancelled node labels, indices, labels on edges, arrow ends, enclosures, table cells and marginal marks were read line by line against the page. Dark isolated drops and faint paper/bleed-through marks with no textual or diagrammatic role were not promoted to punctuation.

Case II's lower-left object is visibly E_{n-1}, not C's E_{n+1}. The minus has no upright. It remains as a possible written slip. Likewise, the isolated fork's lower object is E_n as written; no E_{n-1} is substituted.
The first table's second I row is p=4,q=2. The numeral's closed lobe and crossing upright decide 4. Its relation to the neighbouring table entries was not used to replace it by 1.

The curved inclusion labels occur once in the isolated fork, twice in II and once in III. All four retain delta/partial uncertainty. A parent message reported the same unresolved form on scan 017; no other page or report was inspected by this reader.

The top product X(I) times X(K) is cancelled in full; X(I amalg K) sits immediately beneath as its replacement. The two left objects are X(I) and X(I'). The lower-right initial X and the preceding square's J' show retracing/overwriting, but no independently readable earlier letter or separate cancellation can be established.

The p06 and p20 right verticals are rendered with their small curled ends and without invented full chevrons. Their intended arrow direction remains uncertain. Headless middle and lower hooked strokes elsewhere are also preserved.

The II–V grouping curve, the separator and the separate case-I enclosure are drawings, not strikes through the circled case labels. Case I's enclosure remains open at upper left. Its lower subscript has a doubtful rounded/horizontal mark between p and q.

The first table has top, left and bottom rules and no right rule. The second table has a left stroke and a long bottom boundary. C's closed boxes add absent sides. The cancelled lower-right drawings occupy the gap between the second table's live entry column and live count column; they are not a separate table following the counts.

In the central cancelled region, underlying symbols are typeset as text/math. Cancellation loops are overlaid in TikZ so that their placement relative to the live table columns and the central sketches remains visible. The clear right-shaft numeral 1 in the cancelled E square is retained.

The separate 2 in the cancelled region is placed well above-right of a short capped segment; no attachment to that segment is asserted. The long lower table boundary carries a left raised capped segment, a middle downward tick and a further right tick-pair.

H's two explanatory notes about arrowheads and editorial L/M labels, and its long lower-half synopsis, are explicitly editorial. Their prose, synopsis arrows and counts are excluded from source-word correction counts. Actual source elements omitted from H are restored and itemised; the L/M stand-ins are not additionally counted as invented source words.
No proof, computation, formal verification or mathematical truth claim was made. CHECK_EVENTS is empty. The notes record reading decisions and visible possible slips only.

Main-reader accounting: H expressly calls L and M editorial placeholders and identifies the first node as cancelled and the second as a point. These two placeholders are not counted as manuscript corrections, since their stated source status agrees with the consolidated reading. H has no local doubt macro on this page; marked_in_H is no for these rows.

Main-reader review: the original page and all 22 saved first-pass crops were personally viewed; p13 was re-displayed from its existing crop to settle the partial bottom arrow terminal. No extra crop was made. The page's open places were decided with uncertainty retained locally as recorded. Confidence on entries containing unresolved cancelled readings or ambiguous terminals has been reduced accordingly.
